# AntBox

> AntBox (AntBox Technologies Private Limited) is India's first talent supply technology company, founded on 5 September 2024 in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. AntBox trains students on real work for real companies, gives each student a live Proof of Work instead of a CV, and places them in companies where they contribute from Day 0. For companies, AntBox supplies trained talent with no 3 to 6 month ramp.

## Key facts

- Name: AntBox (always written "AntBox"). Legal name: AntBox Technologies Private Limited.
- Founded: 5 September 2024. Based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. Works with companies in India, the US and Europe.
- What it does: trains students, proves them on real work, and deploys them into companies on Day 0.
- Proof of Work: a live profile of everything a student has shipped (capsule work, Career Sprints, internships, college society work, hackathons, freelance), scored by mentors. Companies read it instead of a CV.
- Selection: through Career Sprints, short sprints on real briefs. No CV filter, no interview round.
- AntBox Academy: specialised tracks, including SDE, Inbound and Customer Success, Data Analytics, GTM Strategy, RevOps and Operations and Delivery, with more added as companies ask; seven hours of daily rigor; 100+ performance metrics.
- Capsules: small teams doing real work for real clients for 6 to 12 months, on live tools and workflows.
- Internship as a Service (for companies): hire from the trained pool, have AntBox run the work in-house, or deploy a capsule into your team.
- Services: product deployment (50+ products deployed in two years), Simulation Team (personalised sales demo environments), GTM and sales development (inbound and outbound).
- Track record since September 2024: 50+ products deployed; 1,000+ customer tickets resolved; software products launched in the US (25+), India (10+) and Europe (5+).
